topic: Raw seen data flow and troubleshooting
summary_markdown: The session focused on diagnosing a failure in the raw seen data feed. Initially, the raw seen data stream had stopped populating due to an issue with the new flow, which was reportedly broken after a sandbox failure and caused errors when inserting raw seen data. After troubleshooting and restarting the system, the data began flowing again, albeit slowly. The rate stabilized at 65MB/s on ens5 during peak times.
decisions: The raw seen data feed is confirmed to be operational.
